title: Patrick Mahomes surprises pumped Travis Kelce as tight end signs Chiefs contract: ‘Home sweet home’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Patrick Mahomes surprises pumped Travis Kelce as tight end signs Chiefs contract: ‘Home sweet home’
sources.description: In a team-produced video published by the Chiefs, Mahomes made an appearance at the team facility via a FaceTime call as Kelce was signing the new contract.
